company.name: Hommect
company.shortDescription: Hommect is an online outsourcing platform for home design.
company.description:
Hommect is an online outsourcing platform for home design. It connects homeowners with architects and interior designers in order to interact, get inspired, and work on projects together easily and efficiently. 

As a homeowner; you get to preview the work of a large number of home designers, and receive all the help you might need when designing your home. You could ask simple questions and get instant answers from professionals, and also preview previous problems that are related to yours. 

Or you could post your project's details on our website and get several offers from different designers, and after reviewing their offers and their previous work on their profiles you get to freely decide who would you like to hire for your project. And to make things easier, Hommect lets you post tasks; so you could just hire a designer to do a small task such as a furniture detail. 

Hommect's role doesn't end here; but after hiring your designer, you get to manage the project with him through our website, you agree on stages, submissions, deadlines and also payments. And we on our turn work on securing the rights of both of you. 

As a designer; you create your personal profile and upload all the work you want to showcase, and we work on advertising it on your behalf in order to reach a huge number of potential clients. You also get to send offers to homeowners through bidding on their projects.
